en.s: The Disaster of Yongjia (simplified Chinese: 永嘉之乱; traditional Chinese: 永嘉之亂) occurred in July 311 CE, when forces of the Han-Zhao dynasty captured and sacked Luoyang, the capital of the Western Jin dynasty. The Han's army committed a massacre of the city's inhabitants, killing the Jin crown prince, a host of ministers, and over 30,000 civilians. They also burnt down the palaces and dug up the Jin dynasty's mausoleums.

zh.s: 永嘉之乱发生于公元311年7月。汉赵军队攻占并洗劫西晋都城洛阳，大肆屠杀城中居民，杀害晋朝皇太子及众多官员和三万多名平民，还焚毁宫殿、掘毁晋朝皇陵。

en.s: The Battle of Stilo or Cape Colonna was fought on 13 or 14 July 982 near Crotone in Calabria between the forces of the Emperor Otto II and his Italo-Lombard allies and those of the Kalbid emir of Sicily, Abu al-Qasim. Some sources claim that the Muslims received support from the Byzantines, in retaliation for Otto's invasion of their province of Apulia, but this is unconfirmed. Al-Qasim, who had declared a Holy War (jihad) against the Germans, retreated when he noticed the unexpected strength of Otto's troops when he was not far from Rossano Calabro.

zh.s: 斯蒂洛战役又称科隆纳角战役，于982年7月13日或14日在卡拉布里亚的克罗托内附近爆发。交战双方分别是奥托二世皇帝及其意大利—伦巴第盟军，以及西西里卡尔比德埃米尔阿布·卡西姆的军队。有些资料称穆斯林得到拜占庭人支持，以报复奥托入侵其阿普利亚行省，但这一说法尚未证实。阿布·卡西姆曾宣布对德国人发动圣战（吉哈德）；他在距离卡拉布里亚罗萨诺不远处发现奥托军队实力超出预期后撤退。

en.t: King Otto II and his Frankish army are defeated by the Muslim army of al-Qasim at Cape Colonna, Southern Italy
en.s: Otto II (955 – 7 December 983), called the Red (German: der Rote), was Holy Roman Emperor from 973 until his death in 983. A member of the Ottonian dynasty, he was the youngest and sole surviving son of Otto the Great and Adelaide of Italy. Otto II was made joint-ruler of Germany in 961, at an early age, and his father named him co-Emperor in 967 to secure his succession to the throne.

zh.t: 奥托二世与法兰克军队在意大利南部科隆纳角被卡西姆率领的穆斯林军队击败
zh.s: 奥托二世（955年—983年12月7日），绰号“红发者”（德语：der Rote），于973年至983年去世期间担任神圣罗马皇帝。他是奥托王朝成员，也是奥托大帝与意大利的阿德莱德唯一存活的幼子。奥托二世早年于961年被立为德国共治国王；967年，父亲又册立他为共治皇帝，以确保其继承皇位。

en.t: Louis VIII becomes King of France upon the death of his father, Philip II
en.s: Louis VIII (5 September 1187 – 8 November 1226), nicknamed The Lion (French: Le Lion), was King of France from 1223 to 1226. As a prince, he invaded England on 21 May 1216 and was excommunicated by a papal legate on 29 May 1216. On 2 June 1216, Louis was proclaimed "King of England" by rebellious barons in London, though never crowned.

zh.t: 腓力二世去世后，路易八世继承法国王位
zh.s: 路易八世（1187年9月5日—1226年11月8日），绰号“狮子”（法语：Le Lion），于1223年至1226年担任法国国王。作为王子，他于1216年5月21日入侵英格兰，并于1216年5月29日被教皇特使开除教籍。1216年6月2日，伦敦的叛乱贵族宣布路易为“英格兰国王”，但他从未加冕。

en.s: The Battle of Thomond (Irish: Áth an Urchair) was fought in Ireland on 14 July 1328 between the forces of William de Burgh and an army led by Brian Bán Ó Briain, Lord of Thomond. It was fought near Thurles in modern County Tipperary and featured powerful Gaelic and Anglo-Irish figures on both sides.

zh.s: 托蒙德战役（爱尔兰语：Áth an Urchair）于1328年7月14日在爱尔兰爆发，交战双方是威廉·德·伯格的军队和托蒙德领主布赖恩·班·奥布莱恩率领的军队。战斗发生在今蒂珀雷里郡瑟尔斯附近，双方都有势力强大的盖尔人和盎格鲁-爱尔兰人物。

en.s: The Battle of Vítkov Hill was a part of the Hussite Wars. The battle pitted the forces of King Sigismund, against Hussite forces under command of Jan Žižka (English: John Zizka). Vítkov Hill was located on the edge of the city of Prague and the battle occurred in a vineyard established by Sigismund's father, Charles IV. It ended with a decisive Hussite victory.
en.n: Battle of Vítkov Hill, decisive victory of Czech Hussite forces commanded by Jan Žižka against Crusade army led by Sigismund, Holy Roman Emperor.

zh.s: 维特科夫山战役是胡斯战争的一部分，交战双方是西吉斯蒙德国王的军队和扬·杰式卡率领的胡斯派军队。维特科夫山位于布拉格城郊，战斗发生在西吉斯蒙德的父亲查理四世开辟的一处葡萄园中。胡斯派最终取得决定性胜利。
zh.n: 维特科夫山战役：扬·杰式卡率领的捷克胡斯派军队大败神圣罗马帝国皇帝西吉斯蒙德率领的十字军。

en.s: The siege of Plzeň lasted from 14 July 1433 to 9 May 1434 and was an important encounter of the Hussite Wars. Hussite troops led by Prokop the Great had unsuccessfully besieged the Catholic city of Plzeň for nine months and twenty three days. Failure to capture one of the last major Catholic cities in Bohemia along with the fall of New Town was a huge blow for the Hussite groups that foreshadowed their decisive defeat in the Battle of Lipany.

zh.s: 比尔森围城战从1433年7月14日持续到1434年5月9日，是胡斯战争中的一场重要战事。大普罗科普率领胡斯军队围攻天主教城市比尔森九个月零二十三天，但未能攻下。胡斯派不仅未能夺取波希米亚最后几座主要天主教城市之一，新城也告陷落；这对胡斯派是沉重打击，并预示了他们后来在利帕尼战役中的决定性失败。

en.s: The Battle of Shelon (Russian: Шелонская битва, romanized: Shelonskaya bitva) was a decisive battle between the forces of the Grand Principality of Moscow under Ivan III (r. 1462–1505) and the Novgorod Republic, which took place on the Shelon River on 14 July 1471. Although Novgorod traditionally recognized the authority of the Russian grand princes, relations between Moscow and Novgorod deteriorated in the 15th century over issues relating to autonomy.

zh.s: 舍隆河战役（俄语：Шелонская битва，转写：Shelonskaya bitva）于1471年7月14日在舍隆河畔爆发，是莫斯科大公国与诺夫哥罗德共和国之间的一场决定性战役。莫斯科军队由伊凡三世（在位1462—1505年）统率。尽管诺夫哥罗德传统上承认俄罗斯大公的权威，但15世纪莫斯科与诺夫哥罗德因自治问题关系恶化。

en.s: The Battle of Vedrosha (Lithuanian: Vedrošos mūšis; Russian: Ведрошская битва) was fought near the Vedrosha river, close to Dorogobuzh (then in the Grand Duchy of Lithuania, now in Russia) on 14 July 1500, during the Second Muscovite–Lithuanian War (1500–1503). In the battle of Vedrosha, Muscovite forces defeated outnumbered Lithuanian troops attacking them. The Battle of Vedrosha was the first major Muscovite victory over Lithuania in the war of 1500–1503.

zh.s: 韦德罗沙战役（立陶宛语：Vedrošos mūšis；俄语：Ведрошская битва）于1500年7月14日爆发，地点在当时属于立陶宛大公国、现属俄罗斯的多罗戈布日附近韦德罗沙河畔。此战是1500至1503年第二次莫斯科—立陶宛战争的一部分。莫斯科军队击败了人数更多、向其发起进攻的立陶宛军队，也是这场战争中莫斯科对立陶宛取得的首场重大胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Rautu Church (Swedish: Slaget vid Rautus kyrka; Russian: Битва при церкви Рауту) was a failed Russian attempt to stop a Swedish relief force headed for Kexholm during the Russo-Swedish War (1656–1658). The Swedes, led by Christoffer Burmeister, successfully repelled the Russian attack at Rautu Church and forced them back. However, they withdrew from Rautu towards Viborg the next day, and the Russian forces claimed control of the battlefield soon after.

zh.s: 劳图教堂战役（瑞典语：Slaget vid Rautus kyrka；俄语：Битва при церкви Рауту）发生在俄瑞战争（1656—1658年）期间。俄军试图阻止一支前往凯克斯霍尔姆的瑞典援军，但未能成功。克里斯托弗·布迈斯特率领的瑞典军在劳图教堂击退俄军进攻，迫使对方后退。不过，瑞典军次日从劳图撤往维堡，不久后俄军宣称控制了战场。

en.s: The Great Turkish War was a series of conflicts between the Ottoman Empire and the Holy League consisting of the Holy Roman Empire, Poland-Lithuania, Venice, Russia, and the Kingdom of Hungary. Intensive fighting began in 1683 and ended with the signing of the Treaty of Karlowitz in 1699. The war was a resounding defeat for the Ottoman Empire, which for the first time lost substantial territory, in Hungary and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, as well as in part of the western Balkans.

zh.s: 大土耳其战争是奥斯曼帝国与神圣同盟之间的一系列冲突。神圣同盟由神圣罗马帝国、波兰立陶宛、威尼斯、俄罗斯和匈牙利王国组成。激烈战事于1683年开始，1699年以签署《卡洛维茨条约》告终。奥斯曼帝国遭到惨败，首次丧失大片领土，包括匈牙利、波兰立陶宛境内地区以及巴尔干半岛西部的部分地区。

en.s: The Naval battle off St. John took place on July 14, 1696, between France and England toward the end of King William's War in the Bay of Fundy off present-day Saint John, New Brunswick. The English ships were sent from Boston to interrupt the supplies being taken by French officer Pierre Le Moyne d'Iberville from Quebec to the capital of Acadia, Fort Nashwaak (Fredericton, New Brunswick) on the Saint John River.

zh.s: 1696年7月14日，威廉王之战末期，法国和英格兰在芬迪湾、今加拿大新不伦瑞克省圣约翰附近交战。英格兰舰船从波士顿出发，试图拦截法国军官皮埃尔·勒莫因·迪贝维尔从魁北克运往阿卡迪亚首府纳什瓦克堡的补给。纳什瓦克堡位于圣约翰河畔，现为新不伦瑞克省弗雷德里克顿。

en.t: An expedition led by Gaspar de Portolá leaves its base in San Diego and sets out to find the Port of Monterey (now Monterey, California)
en.s: The Portolá expedition was a Spanish voyage of exploration in 1769–1770 that was the first recorded European exploration of the interior of the present-day California. It was led by Gaspar de Portolá, governor of Las Californias, the Spanish colonial province that included California, Baja California, and other parts of present-day Mexico and the United States.

zh.t: 加斯帕尔·德·波托拉率领远征队从圣迭戈基地出发，寻找蒙特雷港（今加利福尼亚州蒙特雷）
zh.s: 波托拉远征是1769年至1770年间西班牙组织的一次探险航行，也是有记录以来欧洲人首次探索今加利福尼亚州内陆。远征由加斯帕尔·德·波托拉率领；他是拉斯加利福尼亚省总督，该西班牙殖民省份包括加利福尼亚、下加利福尼亚以及今墨西哥和美国的其他地区。

en.s: The Battle of Fidonisi took place on 14 July 1788 between the fleets of the Russian Empire under Marko Voinovich's lead and the Ottoman Empire under Cezayirli Gazi Hasan Pasha during the Russo-Turkish War (1787–1792) in the area of Snake Island, which in Greek was called Fidonisi (Φιδονήσι). It was a Russian victory.

zh.s: 1788年7月14日，俄土战争（1787—1792年）期间，俄国海军与奥斯曼帝国海军在蛇岛附近交战。俄军由马尔科·沃伊诺维奇指挥，奥斯曼军由杰扎伊尔利·加齐·哈桑帕夏率领。希腊语称蛇岛为菲多尼西（Φιδονήσι）。俄军获胜。

en.s: The Storming of the Bastille (French: Prise de la Bastille [pʁiz də la bastij]) occurred in Paris, France, on the afternoon of 14 July 1789. The medieval fortress, armory, and political prison in Paris known as the Bastille represented royal authority in the center of Paris. The prison contained just seven inmates at the time of its storming but was a symbol of the abuse of the monarchy; its fall was the flashpoint of the French Revolution.

zh.s: 1789年7月14日下午，巴黎民众攻占了法国巴黎的巴士底狱（法语：Prise de la Bastille）。巴士底狱是一座中世纪堡垒、军械库和政治监狱，位于巴黎市中心，象征着王权。被攻占时，狱中只有七名囚犯，但巴士底狱象征着君主专制的压迫；它的陷落成为法国大革命的导火索。

en.t: The Sedition Act of 1798 becomes law in the United States making it a federal crime to write, publish, or utter false or malicious statements about the United States government
en.s: The Alien and Sedition Acts of 1798 were four U.S. statutes that restricted naturalization, empowered the president of the United States to detain and deport foreigners, and criminalized false or malicious statements against the federal government. The laws were endorsed by the Federalist Party, led by President John Adams, on national security grounds in response to the later stages of the French Revolution and ongoing disputes with the French revolutionary government which had culminated in naval skirmishes.

zh.t: 1798年《煽动叛乱法》在美国生效，将撰写、发表或传播针对美国政府的虚假或恶意言论定为联邦罪行
zh.s: 1798年《客籍法》和《煽动叛乱法》共包括四项美国法律，限制入籍，授权美国总统拘押和驱逐外国人，并将针对联邦政府的虚假或恶意言论定为犯罪。这些法律得到约翰·亚当斯总统领导的联邦党支持，理由是维护国家安全；当时法国大革命进入后期，美国与法国革命政府的争端持续，并已发展为海上冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Medina de Rioseco, also known as the Battle of Moclín, was fought during the Peninsular War on 14 July 1808 when a combined body of Spanish militia and regulars moved to rupture the French line of communications to Madrid. General Joaquín Blake's Army of Galicia, under joint command with General Gregorio de la Cuesta, was routed by Marshal Bessières after a badly coordinated but stubborn fight against the French corps north of Valladolid. Bessières exploited the poor coordination between Blake and Cuesta to defeat the Spaniards in detail, with Blake being ejected from a low ridge while Cuesta sat to the rear, and Cuesta failing to recapture the ridge with his own troops.

zh.t: 梅迪纳德里奥塞科战役
zh.s: 梅迪纳德里奥塞科战役又称莫克林战役，于1808年7月14日在半岛战争期间爆发。当时，一支由西班牙民兵和正规军组成的部队试图切断法军通往马德里的交通线。华金·布莱克将军指挥的加利西亚军团与格雷戈里奥·德拉奎斯塔将军共同作战，在巴利亚多利德以北与法军激战，尽管抵抗顽强但配合不佳，最终被贝西埃尔元帅击溃。贝西埃尔利用布莱克与奎斯塔之间的指挥不协调，逐一击败西班牙军队：布莱克被赶下一处低矮山脊，奎斯塔则留在后方，后来也未能率军夺回山脊。

en.s: The Battle of Lapua was fought between Swedish and Russian troops on 14 July 1808 at Lapua, Finland. The battle was a part of the Finnish War of 1808–1809. The Russians had set up defences around Lapua. The Swedes tried to outflank and surround the defending Russians. The Björneborg Regiment under Georg Carl von Döbeln distinguished itself during the battle. In the end the Russians managed to retreat, but the victory was an important one for the Swedish as it allowed them to continue their offensive.

zh.s: 1808年7月14日，瑞典和俄罗斯军队在芬兰拉普阿交战。这场战役是1808至1809年芬兰战争的一部分。俄军在拉普阿周边构筑防线，瑞典军试图迂回包围守军。乔治·卡尔·冯·德贝恩指挥的波尔涅博里团在战斗中表现突出。俄军最终成功撤退，但瑞典获胜意义重大，使其得以继续进攻。

An American squadron of three vessels attacked three British armed whalers, and captured them. en.s: The Battle of Kishegyes (modern-day Mali Iđoš, Vojvodina, Serbia) was a military engagement during the Hungarian Revolution of 1848. Fought from 11–15 July 1849, the battle pitted the Hungarian Revolutionary Army, commanded by Generals Antal Vetter and Richard Guyon, against the Imperial Habsburg Corps led by Lieutenant Field Marshal Josip Jelačić, Ban of Croatia, whose forces included allied Croatian and Serbian units.

zh.s: 基舍盖什战役发生于1848年匈牙利革命期间，地点在今塞尔维亚伏伊伏丁那的马利伊多什。战斗从1849年7月11日持续到15日，交战双方是由安塔尔·韦特尔和理查德·盖永将军指挥的匈牙利革命军，以及由克罗地亚总督约瑟普·耶拉契奇陆军元帅中将率领的哈布斯堡帝国军团；其部队包括克罗地亚和塞尔维亚盟军。

en.t: Exhibition of the Industry of All Nations
en.s: The Exhibition of the Industry of All Nations was a World's Fair held in 1853 in what is now Bryant Park in New York City, in the wake of the highly successful 1851 Great Exhibition in London. It aimed to showcase the new industrial achievements of the world and also to demonstrate the nationalistic pride of a relatively young nation and all that she stood for. Jacob Aaron Westervelt, at that time Mayor of New York, was the President of the exhibition-committee. The general superintendent was Admiral Du Pont. Opening on July 14, 1853 with newly sworn President Franklin Pierce in attendance, the fair was seen by over 1.1 million visitors before it closed on November 14, 1854.

zh.s: 万国工业博览会是1853年在纽约市现今布莱恩特公园举办的世界博览会，此前1851年伦敦万国工业博览会取得巨大成功。展会旨在展示世界最新工业成就，也展现这个相对年轻的国家的民族自豪感及其所代表的价值。时任纽约市长雅各布·亚伦·韦斯特维尔特担任展会委员会主席，杜邦海军上将任总督办。博览会于1853年7月14日开幕，新近就职的总统富兰克林·皮尔斯出席开幕式；截至1854年11月14日闭幕，共吸引超过110万名访客。

en.s: The Battle of Aschaffenburg, sometimes also called The Skirmishes Near Aschaffenburg, was a battle of the Austro-Prussian War on 14 July 1866 between pitting the armies of Prussia on the one hand and parts of the VIII Corps of the German Federal Army on the other side which primarily consisted of soldiers from the Austrian Empire, Hesse-Darmstadt and Hesse-Kassel.

zh.s: 阿沙芬堡战役有时也称阿沙芬堡附近的小规模冲突，于1866年7月14日在普奥战争期间爆发。交战双方是普鲁士军队和德意志邦联军第八军团的部分部队；后者主要由奥地利帝国、黑森-达姆施塔特和黑森-卡塞尔的士兵组成。

en.s: The Chicago Fire of 1874 was a conflagration in Chicago, Illinois, that took place on July 14, 1874. Reports of the extent of the damage vary somewhat, but sources generally agree that the fire burned forty-seven acres just south of the Loop, destroyed 812 structures and killed 20 people. The affected neighborhood had been home to Chicago's community of Jewish immigrants from Russia and Poland, as well as to a significant population of middle-class African-American families; both ethnic groups were displaced in the aftermath of the fire to other neighborhoods on the city's West and South Sides.

zh.s: 1874年7月14日，伊利诺伊州芝加哥发生大火。关于损失规模的报道略有出入，但资料普遍认为，大火烧毁了环区以南47英亩土地上的812栋建筑，造成20人死亡。受灾社区原本居住着来自俄罗斯和波兰的犹太移民，以及大量非裔美国中产家庭。火灾后，这两个群体都被迫迁往芝加哥西区和南区的其他街区。

en.s: The July 1880 Victorian colonial election was held on 14 July 1880 to elect the 11th Parliament of Victoria. All 86 seats in 55 electorates in the Legislative Assembly were up for election, though eight seats were uncontested. There were 31 single-member, 20 two-member and 5 three-member electorates. The Constitutionalist (moderate liberal) government of James Service was defeated by the liberal (or protectionist) opposition led by Graham Berry, who formed a new government on 3 August 1880.

zh.s: 1880年7月14日，维多利亚殖民地举行选举，选出第11届维多利亚议会。立法议会55个选区的86个席位全部改选，其中8席没有竞争者；31个选区选出1名议员，20个选区选出2名，另有5个选区选出3名。詹姆斯·塞维斯领导的宪政派（温和自由派）政府落败，格雷厄姆·贝里领导的自由派（或保护主义派）反对党上台，并于1880年8月3日组建新政府。

en.s: The Socialist International, commonly known as the Second International, was a political international of socialist and labour parties formed in Paris in 1889. At a time of growing industrial working-class movements and the expansion of suffrage, it brought together autonomous national parties into a loose international federation. It continued the work of the First International (1864–1876), from which it inherited both the legacy of Karl Marx and the conflict with anarchists.

zh.s: 社会主义国际通常称为第二国际，是一个由社会主义政党和工党组成的国际组织，于1889年在巴黎成立。当时工业工人运动不断发展，选举权也在扩大；第二国际将各国自治政党联合成松散的国际联盟。它延续了第一国际（1864—1876年）的工作，也继承了卡尔·马克思的思想遗产以及与无政府主义者之间的冲突。

en.s: The Battle of Tientsin, or the Relief of Tientsin, occurred on 13–14 July 1900, during the Boxer Rebellion in Northern China. A multinational military force, representing the Eight-Nation Alliance, rescued a besieged population of foreign nationals in the city of Tianjin (Postal: Tientsin) by defeating the Chinese Imperial army and Boxers.

zh.s: 天津之战又称天津解围战，于1900年7月13日至14日在中国北方的义和团运动期间爆发。代表八国联军的多国部队击败清军和义和团，解救了被围困在天津的外国侨民。

en.s: The Boxer Rebellion, also known as the Boxer Uprising, Boxer Movement, Yihetuan Movement (traditional Chinese: 義和團運動; simplified Chinese: 义和团运动), or Boxer War, was an uprising in North China between 1899 and 1901, towards the end of the Qing dynasty, by the Society of Righteous and Harmonious Fists. Its members were known as the "Boxers" in English, owing to many of them practicing Chinese martial arts, which at the time were referred to as "Chinese boxing".
en.n: Armies of the Eight-Nation Alliance capture Tientsin during the Boxer Rebellion.

zh.s: 义和团运动又称义和拳运动或义和团战争，是清朝末年1899年至1901年间发生在中国北方的一场起义，由义和团发起。由于许多成员练习当时被称为“中国拳术”的武术，英语中将他们称作“拳民”。
zh.n: 义和团运动期间，八国联军攻占天津。

en.t: Peruvian explorer and farmer Agustín Lizárraga discovers Machu Picchu, the "Lost City of the Incas"
en.s: Agustín Lizárraga Ruiz (Spanish: [aɣusˈtin liˈsaraɣa] 12 June 1865 – 11 February 1912) was a Peruvian explorer and farmer who visited the Inca site of Machu Picchu on 14 July 1902, nine years before American explorer Hiram Bingham brought it to international attention.

zh.t: 秘鲁探险家兼农民阿古斯丁·利萨拉加发现印加“失落之城”马丘比丘
zh.s: 阿古斯丁·利萨拉加·鲁伊斯（西班牙语：[aɣusˈtin liˈsaraɣa]；1865年6月12日—1912年2月11日）是秘鲁探险家和农民。1902年7月14日，他到访印加遗址马丘比丘，比美国探险家海勒姆·宾厄姆使其受到国际关注早了九年。

en.s: The 1905 Carlisle by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 14 July 1905. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.s: 1905年卡莱尔补选是一次议会补选，于1905年7月14日举行。该选区通过简单多数制选出一名议员，进入英国下议院。

en.s: The Arab Revolt (Arabic: الثورة العربية al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya), also known as the Great Arab Revolt (الثورة العربية الكبرى al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā), was an armed uprising by the Hashemite-led Arabs of the Hejaz against the Ottoman Empire amidst the Middle Eastern theatre of World War I. On the basis of the McMahon–Hussein Correspondence, exchanged between Henry McMahon of the United Kingdom and Hussein bin Ali of the Kingdom of Hejaz, the rebellion against the ruling Turks was officially initiated at Mecca on 10 June 1916.
en.n: Beginning of the McMahon–Hussein Correspondence between Hussein bin Ali, Sharif of Mecca and the British official Henry McMahon concerning the Arab Revolt against the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 阿拉伯起义（阿拉伯语：الثورة العربية，al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya），又称大阿拉伯起义（الثورة العربية الكبرى，al-Thawra al-'Arabiyya al-Kubrā），是第一次世界大战中东战场期间，由哈希姆家族领导的汉志阿拉伯人反抗奥斯曼帝国的武装起义。根据英国亨利·麦克马洪与汉志王国麦加谢里夫侯赛因·本·阿里之间的《麦克马洪—侯赛因通信》，反抗土耳其统治者的叛乱于1916年6月10日在麦加正式爆发。
zh.n: 侯赛因·本·阿里（麦加谢里夫）与英国官员亨利·麦克马洪开始就阿拉伯人反抗奥斯曼帝国起义进行通信。

en.s: The Capture of Trônes Wood (8–14 July 1916) was a tactical incident in the First World War, fought by the British Fourth Army and the German 2nd Army, during the Battle of the Somme of 1916. Trônes Wood lay on the northern slope of Montauban ridge, between Bernafay Wood and Guillemont. The wood dominated the southern approach to Longueval and Trônes Alley, a German communication trench between Bernafay Wood and the northern tip of Trônes Wood to Guillemont.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 夺取特朗森林（1916年7月8日至14日）是第一次世界大战索姆河战役期间的一场战术行动，交战双方是英国第四集团军和德国第二集团军。特朗森林位于蒙托邦山脊北坡，介于贝尔纳费森林和吉耶蒙之间。森林俯瞰隆格瓦勒南侧的进路，也控制着一条德军交通壕：这条壕沟从贝尔纳费森林通往特朗森林北端，再延伸至吉耶蒙。

en.t: The Battle of Delville Wood began as an action within the Battle of the Somme, lasting until 3 September 1916
en.s: The Battle of Delville Wood (15 July – 3 September 1916) was a series of engagements in the 1916 Battle of the Somme in the First World War, between the armies of the German Empire and the British Empire. Delville Wood (Bois d'Elville), was a thick tangle of trees, chiefly beech and hornbeam (the wood has been replanted with oak and birch by the South African government), with dense hazel thickets, intersected by grassy rides, to the east of Longueval.

zh.t: 德尔维尔森林战役作为索姆河战役的一部分爆发，持续至1916年9月3日
zh.s: 德尔维尔森林战役（1916年7月15日至9月3日）是第一次世界大战期间1916年索姆河战役中的一系列交战，交战双方为德意志帝国和大英帝国军队。德尔维尔森林（Bois d'Elville）树木茂密，主要由山毛榉和鹅耳枥组成；南非政府后来在林中补种了橡树和桦树。林内还有浓密的榛树丛，并有草地小径穿过，位于隆格瓦尔以东。

en.s: The National Protection War (simplified Chinese: 护国战争; traditional Chinese: 護國戰爭; pinyin: Hù guó zhànzhēng), also known as the Anti-Monarchy War, or the Third Revolution, was a civil war that took place in China from December 1915 to July 1916. Following the overthrow of the Qing dynasty three years previously, the Republic of China was established in its place.

zh.s: 护国战争又称反帝制战争或第三次革命，是1915年12月至1916年7月发生在中国的一场内战。清朝于三年前被推翻，中华民国由此建立。

en.s: The Great World (Chinese: 大世界; pinyin: Dà Shìjìe; Shanghainese: Da Syga) is an amusement arcade and entertainment complex located in Shanghai, China. Built in 1917 on the corner of Avenue Edward VII (now Yan'an Road) and Yu Ya Ching Road (now Middle Xizang Road), it was the first and for a long time the most influential indoor amusement arcade in Shanghai, so much so that it spawned imitations all over China.

zh.s: 大世界（中文：大世界；拼音：Dà Shìjìe；上海话：Da Syga）是位于中国上海的游乐场和娱乐综合体。它于1917年建成，位于爱德华七世大道（今延安路）与虞洽卿路（今西藏中路）交叉口，是上海第一家、并长期以来最具影响力的室内游乐场，影响力之大，以至于中国各地都出现了仿建场所。

en.s: The Battle of Abu Tellul (called the Affair of Abu Tellul by the British Battles Nomenclature Committee) was fought on 14 July 1918 during the Sinai and Palestine Campaign of World War I after German and Ottoman Empire forces attacked the British Empire garrison in the Jordan Valley. The valley had been occupied by the Egyptian Expeditionary Force (EEF) from February 1918 when Jericho was captured. Following two raids east of the River Jordan by the EEF the first in March and second in April the defence of the valley became the responsibility of the Desert Mounted Corps.

zh.s: 阿布泰卢勒战役于1918年7月14日爆发，是第一次世界大战西奈及巴勒斯坦战役的一部分。德军和奥斯曼帝国军队袭击了英帝国驻守约旦河谷的守军。1918年2月，埃及远征军攻占耶利哥后开始占领该河谷。远征军于3月和4月两次突袭约旦河东岸后，河谷的防务交由沙漠骑兵军负责。英国战役命名委员会将此战称为“阿布泰卢勒事件”。

en.s: General elections were held in Romania in July 1927. The Chamber of Deputies was elected on 7 July, whilst the Senate was elected in three stages on 10, 12 and 14 July. The result was a victory for the governing National Liberal Party (PNL), which won 318 of the 387 seats in the Chamber of Deputies and 92 of the 110 seats in the Senate elected through universal male vote.

zh.s: 1927年7月，罗马尼亚举行大选。众议院选举于7月7日进行，参议院选举分三轮举行，日期为7月10日、12日和14日。执政的国家自由党获胜，在众议院387席中赢得318席，在由男性普选产生的参议院110席中赢得92席。

en.s: General elections were held in Cuba on 14 July 1940. Fulgencio Batista won the presidential election running under the People's Socialist Coalition banner, whilst the Partido Auténtico emerged as the largest party in the House of Representatives. Voter turnout was 73.4%.

zh.s: 1940年7月14日，古巴举行大选。富尔亨西奥·巴蒂斯塔以人民社会主义联盟候选人的身份赢得总统选举；真正党则成为众议院第一大党。投票率为73.4%。

en.s: The Syria–Lebanon campaign, also known as Operation Exporter, was the invasion of Syria and Lebanon (then controlled by Vichy France, a vassal state of Nazi Germany) in June and July 1941 by British Empire forces, during the Second World War. On 1 April 1941, after the Iraqi coup d'état, Iraq was controlled by Iraqi nationalists led by Rashid Ali al-Gaylani, who appealed for Italian and German support.

zh.s: 叙利亚—黎巴嫩战役又称“出口者行动”，是第二次世界大战期间英国帝国军队于1941年6月和7月入侵叙利亚与黎巴嫩的战役。当时两地由维希法国控制，维希法国是纳粹德国的附庸政权。1941年4月1日伊拉克政变后，由拉希德·阿里·盖拉尼领导的伊拉克民族主义者控制了伊拉克，并向意大利和德国寻求支持。

en.t: In the Wardha session of Congress, the "Quit India" resolution is approved, authorising Mahatma Gandhi to campaign for India's independence from Britain
en.s: The Quit India Movement was a political campaign launched at the Bombay session of the All India Congress Committee by Mahatma Gandhi on 8 August 1942, during World War II, demanding an end to British rule in India. After Britain failed to secure Indian support for the British war effort with the Cripps Mission, Gandhi made a call to Do or Die in his Quit India speech delivered in Bombay on 8 August 1942 at the Gowalia Tank Maidan.

zh.t: 国大党在瓦尔达会议上通过“退出印度”决议，授权圣雄甘地推动印度脱离英国独立
zh.s: 退出印度运动是圣雄甘地于1942年8月8日在全印度国大委员会孟买会议上发起的政治运动，要求结束英国对印度的统治。英国未能通过克里普斯使团争取印度支持英国的战争努力后，甘地在1942年8月8日于孟买戈瓦利亚坦克广场发表“退出印度”演说，呼吁人们“要么行动，要么牺牲”。

en.s: The Battle of Mubo was a series of actions in the Mubo area of the Territory of New Guinea between Australian and Japanese forces which took place between 22 April and 14 July 1943, during World War II. The battle formed part of the wider Salamaua–Lae campaign, and was fought in the early stages of the campaign.

zh.s: 穆博战役是第二次世界大战期间澳大利亚和日本军队在新几内亚领地穆博地区进行的一系列战斗，持续时间为1943年4月22日至7月14日。该战役是萨拉毛亚—莱城战役的一部分，发生在这场战役的早期阶段。

en.s: The Battle of La Haye-du-Puits was fought between the armies of the United States and Germany as part of the Normandy Campaign of World War II. Following the Allied invasion of Normandy on D-Day, 6 June 1944, US First Army under the command of Lieutenant General Omar Bradley began an advance to the south, aiming to break through the German defenses and secure a line from Coutances to Saint-Lô.

zh.s: 拉艾迪皮战役是第二次世界大战诺曼底战役的一部分，交战双方为美国和德国军队。1944年6月6日盟军登陆诺曼底后，由奥马尔·布拉德利中将指挥的美国第一集团军开始向南推进，目标是突破德军防线，并控制从库唐斯到圣洛的一条战线。

en.s: The Italian Parliament (Italian: Parlamento italiano) is the national parliament of the Italian Republic. It is the representative body of Italian citizens and is the successor to the Parliament of the Kingdom of Sardinia (1848–1861), the Parliament of the Kingdom of Italy (1861–1943), the transitional National Council (1945–1946) and the Constituent Assembly (1946–1948). It is a bicameral legislature with 600 elected members and a small number of unelected members (senatori a vita).
en.n: Palmiro Togliatti, leader of the Italian Communist Party, is shot and wounded near the Italian Parliament.

zh.s: 意大利议会（意大利语：Parlamento italiano）是意大利共和国的国家议会，代表意大利公民。它承继了撒丁王国议会（1848—1861年）、意大利王国议会（1861—1943年）、过渡时期的国民议会（1945—1946年）和制宪会议（1946—1948年）。意大利议会实行两院制，有600名民选议员和少量非民选议员（终身参议员）。
zh.n: 意大利共产党领袖帕尔米罗·陶里亚蒂在意大利议会附近遭枪击并受伤。

en.t: Korean War: North Korean troops began attacking the headquarters of the American 24th Infantry Division in present-day Daejeon, South Korea
en.s: The Battle of Taejon (16–20 July 1950) was an early battle of the Korean War, between U.S. and North Korean forces. Forces of the United States Army attempted to defend the headquarters of the 24th Infantry Division. The 24th Infantry Division was overwhelmed by numerically superior forces of the Korean People's Army (KPA) at the major city and transportation hub of Daejon (then spelt Taejon).

zh.t: 朝鲜战争：朝鲜军队开始进攻驻扎在今韩国大田的美国陆军第24步兵师司令部
zh.s: 大田战役（1950年7月16日至20日）是朝鲜战争初期美国与朝鲜军队之间的一场战斗。美国陆军试图守住第24步兵师司令部。朝鲜人民军（KPA）兵力占优，迅速击溃了美军第24步兵师；战场位于重要城市和交通枢纽大田，当时拼作Taejon。

en.s: The 1951 British Grand Prix was a Formula One motor race held on 14 July 1951 at the Silverstone Circuit in Northamptonshire, England. It was race 5 of 8 in the 1951 World Championship of Drivers and was contested over 90 laps. The race was the first victory for José Froilán González, and was also the first of many for the Scuderia Ferrari team.

en.s: The 6th Locarno Film Festival was held from 2 July to 14 July 1952 in Locarno, Switzerland. It was originally planned to end one day earlier, but was extended to show the film The City Stands Trial (Processo alla città). This year's event was notable for its political controversies. Many festival goers were angry when the festival refused to bar former Nazi and SS member, Ludwig Carl Moyzisch, from the festival.

en.s: The 14 July Revolution or the 1958 Iraqi coup d'état took place on 14 July 1958 in Iraq, resulting in the overthrow of the Hashemite monarchy established by King Faisal I in 1921 under the auspices of the British. King Faisal II, the regent and Crown Prince 'Abd al-Ilah, and Prime Minister Nuri al-Said were assassinated during this coup. A result of several different grievances with Hashemite Iraqi policies, the coup d'état established the Republic of Iraq. From 14 July 1958 until 2003, Iraq remained a de facto Arab nationalist and socialist one-party state.

zh.s: 7月14日革命又称1958年伊拉克政变，于1958年7月14日在伊拉克发生，推翻了英国支持下由费萨尔一世于1921年建立的哈希姆王朝。政变期间，费萨尔二世国王、摄政王兼王储阿卜杜勒·伊拉和首相努里·赛义德遭到杀害。政变源于对哈希姆王朝多项政策的不满，并建立了伊拉克共和国。此后直到2003年，伊拉克事实上一直是一个阿拉伯民族主义和社会主义的一党制国家。

en.s: Northwest Orient Airlines Flight 1–11 was a Northwest Orient Airlines flight from New York City to Manila, with stopovers in Seattle, Anchorage, Tokyo, and Okinawa. On July 14, 1960, the Douglas DC-7C serving the flight ditched in the ocean 8 km (5.0 mi) northeast off Polillo Island, Quezon, Philippines. Of the 58 people on board, 57 survived with 44 suffering from minor injuries and 1 passenger losing her life.

en.s: The 1965 Greek Cup final was the 22nd final of the Greek Cup. The match took place on 14 July 1965 at Karaiskakis Stadium. The contesting teams were Olympiacos and Panathinaikos. en.s: The Battle of Lenadoon was a series of gun battles fought over a six day period from 9–14 July 1972 between the Provisional IRA and the British Army. It started on Thursday, 9 July 1972 in and around the Lenadoon Avenue area and spread to other places in Belfast. Loyalist paramilitaries and the Official Irish Republican Army were involved in some of the incidents. 28 people in total were killed in Belfast according to the CAIN: Sutton Index of Deaths.

en.s: The 1984 New Zealand general election was a nationwide vote to determine the composition of the 41st New Zealand Parliament. It marked the beginning of the Fourth Labour Government, with David Lange's Labour Party defeating the long-serving Prime Minister, Robert Muldoon, of the National Party. It was also the last election in which the Social Credit Party won seats as an independent entity.

en.s: General elections were held in Bolivia on 14 July 1985. As no candidate for the presidency received over 50% of the vote, the National Congress was required to elect a President on 4 August. en.s: The Kensington by-election, in Kensington, on 14 July 1988 was held after the death of Conservative Member of Parliament (MP) Brandon Rhys-Williams. Normally a relatively safe Conservative seat, it was narrowly won by Dudley Fishburn, who would go on to retain the seat in 1992. It was the first by-election of that parliament, which had begun after the general election of June 1987, and would last until the next election in April 1992.

en.s: Shoot Boxing – S-Cup 1996 was a shoot boxing event promoted by Caesar Takeshi. It was a qualifier for the Shoot Boxing World Tournament 1997, featuring four elimination fights with all bouts fought under Shoot Boxing Rules (70kg/154lbs weight class) involving eight fighters from across the world. The eight finalists were a mixture of invitees or had been involved in the 1995 tournament (for more information on these finalists, see the bulleted list below). As well as competition bouts there were also five 'Super Fights', three fought under Shoot Boxing Rules (various weight classes), two fought under MMA Rules, and a 'Special Fight' fought under Kyokushin Karate Rules (75kg/165lbs weight class).

zh.s: Shoot Boxing—1996年S-Cup赛是由武竹凯撒主办的一场立技搏击赛事，也是1997年Shoot Boxing世界锦标赛的资格赛。赛事设有四场淘汰赛，八名来自世界各地的选手均按70公斤级Shoot Boxing规则参赛。八名决赛选手中，有些受邀参赛，有些曾参加1995年赛事。除正式比赛外，赛事还安排了五场“超级战”：三场采用不同量级的Shoot Boxing规则，两场采用综合格斗规则；另有一场特别赛，按75公斤级极真空手道规则进行。

en.s: The 1996 Munster Senior Hurling Championship finals were two hurling matches played in July 1996. The first game was played at the Gaelic Grounds in Limerick and finished in a draw 0–19 to 1–16, after Tipperary at one stage had a ten-point lead. The replay was played a week later on 14 July at Páirc Uí Chaoimh, Cork, County Cork, and saw Limerick claim their second first Munster Championship of the decade, winning on a scoreline of 4–7 to 0–16.

en.s: The 1996 Major League Soccer All-Star Game was the first Major League Soccer All-Star Game, a soccer match involving all-stars from Major League Soccer. en.s: New Horizons is an interplanetary space probe launched as a part of NASA's New Frontiers program. Launched in 2006, it became the first spacecraft to perform a flyby study and capture high-resolution photographs of Pluto and its moons during its encounter. It was engineered by the Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) and the Southwest Research Institute (SwRI), with a team led by Alan Stern.

en.s: On the evening of 14 July 2016, a 19-tonne cargo truck was deliberately driven into crowds of people celebrating Bastille Day on the Promenade des Anglais in Nice, France, resulting in the deaths of 86 people and injuring 458 others. The driver was Mohamed Lahouaiej-Bouhlel, a Tunisian living in France. The attack ended following an exchange of gunfire, during which he was shot and killed by police. The Islamic State claimed responsibility for the attack, saying Lahouaiej-Bouhlel answered its "calls to target citizens of coalition nations that fight the Islamic State".

en.t: July 2020 New Zealand National Party leadership election
en.s: An election for the parliamentary leadership of the New Zealand National Party by its caucus was held on 14 July 2020, after incumbent Todd Muller resigned earlier that day citing health reasons. Judith Collins became leader of the National Party and of the Opposition of New Zealand.

en.s: The 2024 Copa América final was an international soccer match to determine the winners of the CONMEBOL 2024 Copa América. The match was played at Hard Rock Stadium in Miami Gardens, Florida, on July 14, 2024. Kickoff was delayed by over an hour and twenty minutes due to overcrowding and other incidents which occurred near the stadium.

en.s: The UEFA Euro 2024 final was a football match that determined the winners of UEFA Euro 2024. The match was the seventeenth final of the European Championship, a quadrennial tournament contested by the men's national teams of the member associations of UEFA to decide the champions of Europe. The match was held at the Olympiastadion in Berlin, Germany, on 14 July 2024, and was contested by Spain, in their fifth final, and England, in their second final, but their first appearance in a major men's tournament final held outside their home country.

zh.s: 2024年欧洲足球锦标赛决赛决出了该届赛事冠军，也是欧洲锦标赛历史上的第17场决赛。欧洲锦标赛每四年举办一次，由欧足联成员协会的男子国家队争夺欧洲冠军。比赛于2024年7月14日在德国柏林奥林匹克体育场举行，西班牙第五次参加决赛，英格兰则第二次闯入决赛；这也是英格兰首次在本土以外参加大型男子赛事决赛。
